'''Stoneleg''' was a particularly strong and dangerous [[walluga]] that lived in the [[Rodian Hunting Grounds|Etyyy region]] on the planet [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], a [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] tracked down and [[Death/Legends|killed]] Silkthrower to impress the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] hunter [[Sordaan Xris]] and earn the prestigious [[Trophy for Excellence in Hunting in Etyyy]].
